text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as we're preparing for the
upcoming
summer camp, Yamanin
Zephyr informs me that
she has
something she wants to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: About summer camp this year...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If it's all right with you, I'd like to train
with
Bakushin O and Flower as much as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In the generation below me, yes.
However...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O possesses the speed
of a blast
wind, and she uses it to win
sprints with
unstoppable momentum.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower, though delicate as a
blossom, has
skill on par with Sakura
Bakushin O, and is a
roaring floral wind
in her own right.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are up-and-coming
sprinters who've
announced they'll be
entering this year's Sprinters
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Put simply, those two are the fiercest
storms we'll
face on our way to
conquering the short-distance
races.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly why I want to compete
against
them as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I've learned that if I involve my fans and
rivals in
my efforts, I will become the
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to go the extra mile
this
summer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wish to bathe in the blast winds, in the
floral
winds—to breathe them all in and
turn them into
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Honestly... I'm quite surprised.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I hadn't noticed how much
Yamanin
Zephyr has grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's no longer the fierce but fragile
person she
once was. Seeing Yamanin
Zephyr like this—purer
than anyone, but
with a raging spirit...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So please—let me do this, so I can grow
stronger
and become a true tempest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's deepened her inner self to the
extent that
she can now fling herself at
hardships and gain
strength from the
experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's come to embody the atmosphere
that
envelops all things... and the wind it
generates.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: HERE YOU ARE!
choice_data_list: わかった！さっそく調整――
choice_data_list_en: Got it! Let's adjust it right away—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You called my name! And now I'm here!
Class rep
Sakura Bakushin O, ready to
Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ahh, um... I'm Nishino Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we were just looking for you,
too,
Zephyr. We wanted to talk to you
about
something!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Training together during summer camp is
a great
idea! Let's definitely do it!
DEFINITELY
DEFINITELY!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And then, Zephyr, at the Sprinters
Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow you away with my Class Rep
Gale!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah?! M-me too! With my, um... Flowery
Gust!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe, if you say so...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll gladly take you both on, for I am the
Zephyr
Wind.
